outgoing.name: Germany
outgoing.excerpt: From 1902 to 1906 Kell was head of the German section of the War Office, eventually rising to the rank of staff captain.

outgoing.name: Winston Churchill
outgoing.excerpt: Removed from office by Winston Churchill during World War II, Kell was knighted for his services ( KCMG) shortly before his death.
